CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS digest_seo_details (
 digest_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES weekly_digests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 site_url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
 payload JSONB NOT NULL,
 computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_digest_seo_details_site_url ON digest_seo_details (site_url)
